title: Engineering Graduate Program
location: Melbourne (Mulgrave VIC) with FIFO site year; also Perth, Sydney, Brisbane, Adelaide
content_text: Austral Construction Engineering Graduate Program page. Austral is an engineering and construction contractor in mining and infrastructure, part of Keller Group plc. Two-year graduate program: Year 1 office-based tendering, planning and design; Year 2 FIFO site-based project delivery. Enrolment in Engineers Australia Graduate Development Program; mentoring; Competency Framework. About you: completed or completing a Civil, Construction, Structural or related Engineering degree; long-term construction career interest; willing to work FIFO; strong communication and teamwork; hold full Australian working rights and a current driver's licence. EOIs from third-year students also welcome. If you are interested in joining the program, please contact careers@australconstruction.com.au. Melbourne Office: Building 1, Level 1.01A, 327-333 Police Road Mulgrave VIC 3170.
apply_instructions: Email careers@australconstruction.com.au to join the graduate program.
